description: A Smarty plugin function for 'sugar_getimage' that generates HTML for images or sprites within the SuiteCRM/SugarCRM framework. It includes license and author information, and defines a function that retrieves images using the SugarThemeRegistry.

methods.name: smarty_function_sugar_getimage
methods.description: Generates HTML for an image or sprite based on parameters, utilizing the SugarThemeRegistry to retrieve the image.
